script:
set -Eeuo pipefail
aws s3 cp s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/inputs/vllm-rps-v1.tar.gz /tmp/vllm-rps-v1.tar.gz --region us-east-1 --no-progress
printf '%s  %s\n' a09de0870f410e4583fe6e7a5c6723891da4f36a7e494986c587d0858842dcbd /tmp/vllm-rps-v1.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /tmp/vllm-rps-v1.tar.gz -C /opt/karpo
cat > /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/launch-dual-v1.sh <<'RUN'
set -Eeuo pipefail
OUT=/opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results
finish() {
 result=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$result" > "$OUT/setup/dual-launch-exit.txt"
 aws s3 cp "$OUT/setup/" s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/results/vllm-rps100-20261120/setup/ --recursive --region us-east-1 --no-progress || true
}
trap finish EXIT
exec >> "$OUT/setup/dual-launch.log" 2>&1
for attempt in $(seq 1 300); do
 if [ -f "$OUT/setup/dual-install-exit.txt" ]; then break; fi
 sleep 5
done
test "$(cat "$OUT/setup/dual-install-exit.txt")" = 0
/opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python -m pip install --no-deps /opt/karpo/serving/vllm_karpo
/opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python /opt/karpo/tests/test_vllm_rps.py > "$OUT/setup/dual-harness-tests.log" 2>&1
/opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python -u /opt/karpo/scripts/vllm_rps_suite.py --name dual-fp8-v1 --gpus 2 --replicas 1 2 --batches 1 2 4 8 --seconds 20
RUN
systemd-run --unit=karpo-rps-dual-v1 --property=RuntimeMaxSec=5400 /bin/bash /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/launch-dual-v1.sh
